messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled model enable: catalyst-13b-v1 -> model-catalog at 2024-06-15T17:45Z change-window. Canary 10% for 30m in us-west + eu-west. Rollback thresholds: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 120ms. runbook: /runbooks/catalyst-enable.md

maria: Ack. Can we confirm fallback ordering? If catalyst fails, fallback should prefer catalyst-13b-quant-v1 then nova-7b-stable, then legacy-13b. Need explicit ordering in catalog.

devon: +1 on explicit ordering. Also recommend pinning nova-7b-stable in EU until telemetry warms up (some customers in eu have strict latency SLOs).

kevin: Canary progression plan: 10% for 30m, if gates pass -> 50% for 15m, then 100%. Tag telemetry with `catalyst-canary`. Make sure traces and embeddings are exported to BigQuery.

ops-qa: Adding telemetry gates: request_error_rate, p95_latency, and semantic-regression against eval set (eval id: catalyst-canary-v1). I'll set alerts at the thresholds and add an automated hold if any gate trips.

maria: Release note snippet added to PR: "Enable catalyst-13b-v1: improved contextual understanding, reduced hallucination on long-context prompts." Commit sha: abcdef1234. Model variants: catalyst-13b-v1, catalyst-13b-quant-v1.

devon: Please confirm catalog fallback list exactly reads: ["catalyst-13b-quant-v1", "nova-7b-stable", "legacy-13b"]. Explicit JSON entry so deploybot honors it.

maria: Kickoff command (ready):
```bash
deploybot enable-catalog --model catalyst-13b-v1 --percent 10 --window 30m --tag catalyst-canary --commit abcdef1234
```

deploy-bot: Canary initiated: catalyst-13b-v1 at 10% (us-west, eu-west). Window 30m. runbook: /runbooks/catalyst-enable.md. Observability tags: catalyst-canary.

kevin: Observability note: p95 in us-west creeping to ~160ms, error rate 0.8% (below threshold) but latency > p95 threshold. Holding progression to 50% and starting quick triage.

maria: Hold progression. Do NOT advance to 50%. Ops-qa please dump traces and failing prompts.

ops-qa: Dumped telemetry snapshot -> uploaded to gs://redwood-telemetry/catalyst/canary/7420001110.tar.gz. Pattern: p95 spike correlates with long-context prompts with many tool-calls. Attaching a few sample prompts in the bucket.

devon: Applying a temporary regional pin for EU to avoid user impact:
`deploybot pin-model --region eu-west --model nova-7b-stable --reason "short-term pin during catalyst canary"`

deploy-bot: Pin applied: nova-7b-stable pinned in eu-west. Routing updated.

maria: After triage we prefer a safe rollback rather than iterate in-catalog. Initiating rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for catalyst-13b-v1. Aborting canary. Reverting catalog ordering to previous commit.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Traffic restored to pre-canary state. Canary aborted at ~12 minutes.

julie: Noted. Scheduling a postmortem for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Please include failing prompt list, eval traces, and any kernel/runtime logs.

maria: Thanks all. We'll validate quant variant locally and re-run a smaller canary focusing on the long-context prompt subset before another wide rollout.

kevin: +1, also recommend adding a short synthetic test in the preflight that hits the long-context path.

maria: Good call. I'll add it to the preflight script and re-run staging.
